results.rationale: Consistency: black shell, paired red crown stripes, red chin design, dark visor and gray background are retained; orientation-dependent visibility/reflections are excluded. Instruction: the helmet turns toward front but remains viewed from above and somewhat obliquely, unlike the symmetrical eye-level reference with a much shallower visible crown. Quality: smooth shell, coherent visor edges and plausible glossy reflections.

Consistency: white housing, USB Charger label, plug, cables and wood floor retain their appearance and layout outside the port edit. Instruction: all ten USB ports and labels disappear, leaving zero interfaces rather than six. Quality: a clean solid housing with coherent plug, cables, perspective and shadows, free of distracting artifacts.
